The final and largest impact of the AFES on natural resources is gasoline savings. As mentioned previously, the agency has yet to decide upon the magnitude of any fuel economy penalty due to the MY 1979 emission standard. Also, comments by the manufacturers to the NPRM have persuaded the agency to consider setting a separate fuel economy standard for a class of NPA's considered to be recreational-type vehicles with off-road capability. Therefore, gasoline savings have been determined for a possible MY 1979 fuel economy standard range of 17.8 mpg to 18.7 mpg for most NPA's and 16.2 mpg to 17.4 mpg for the recreational-type NPA's with off-road capability. The range 17.8 mpg to 18.7 mpg is the original proposal minus the maximum penalty indicated by the manufacturers in their comments to the NPRM.
